audit_items.proof_trace: handle_repay reads obligation_old_borrow_amount via unsafe_debt_amount() at line 465 BEFORE obligation-level interest is accrued (which happens inside repay_debt at line 469), yielding a stale pre-accrue amount. This stale old_value is passed to emode_group.update_asset_borrow(old=stale, new=post-accrue-minus-repaid) at line 480, causing the emode group borrow tracker to be permanently inflated by the accrued-but-unrecorded interest on each repay. No reset or sync mechanism exists for assets_borrows, so the inflation accumulates indefinitely.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Over repeated repay operations (or by deliberately letting interest accrue between repays), the emode group's borrow tracker drifts above the actual outstanding debt, eventually causing emode_borrow_limit_exceeded to reject legitimate borrows before the true limit is reached, creating a gradual DoS on borrowing within the emode group.
